Caries is one of the most common dental diseases and can affect people of all ages. Early detection and treatment of caries is crucial to prevent further damage and maintain dental health. At KU64, we offer a wide range of treatment options to restore your dental health and well-being.
Watch out for tooth decay! But what exactly is it?

Caries is a pathological change in the tooth tissue and dentine, commonly known as tooth decay or cavities. The development of caries is a complex microbiological process in which bacterial acid formation attacks the tooth surface. This results in the breakdown of enamel and dentine, leading to holes or cavities in the teeth. The symptoms of caries are throbbing toothache, bleeding gums , increased tooth sensitivity and the typical discolouration of the tooth surface.
Caries treatment – permanently beautiful teeth

There are various ways to effectively treat tooth decay. The appropriate treatment always depends on the severity and extent of the decay. The first step is usually to prevent it from getting worse, as tooth decay usually starts with fairly small and rather superficial lesions. It is therefore advisable to have regular dental check-ups to detect tooth decay at an early stage. The earlier tooth decay is treated, the better the prospects for dental health and minimising problems later on.
Treatment options for tooth decay

For small to medium-sized cavities, the dentist can remove the diseased area and fill the resulting hole with a filling. This prevents the cavity from spreading further and restores the normal tooth structure. Commonly used materials for fillings are composite resin or amalgam.
Info: An amalgam filling, colloquially referred to as a ‘plomb’, is a dental filling made of mercury alloys.

If the caries has reached the dental pulp, this can lead to severe pain and inflammation. In such cases, root canal treatment is necessary. During this procedure, the diseased pulp, i.e. the soft tissue of the tooth, is removed, the root canal is cleaned and disinfected, and the tooth is then sealed.

If a large part of the tooth is damaged by caries, a dental crown is usually required. In this treatment, the affected tooth is sealed and then a custom-made crown made of metal, porcelain or ceramic is placed on the tooth. This protects the tooth and preserves its functionality.

In very advanced cases, where the tooth unfortunately cannot be saved or it is simply not advisable to preserve it for other reasons, extraction is recommended. This involves the dentist pulling the tooth. However, this is usually only considered as a last resort. In such cases, our team at KU64 will be happy to advise you on dental prostheses and provide you with extensive information on treatment options.
Treatment options for preventing tooth decay
There are many ways to protect yourself from tooth decay and prevent the disease. At KU64, we recommend the following measures to our patients to prevent tooth decay:
Good brushing routine & healthy oral hygiene

Good oral hygiene and dental care, including a daily toothbrushing routine, are crucial for preventing tooth decay. This includes thorough toothbrushing at least twice a day, preferably in the morning and evening, using a fluoride toothpaste. Regular toothbrushing and good dental care help to remove plaque, in which bacteria accumulate. These bacteria produce acid, which causes tooth decay. In addition, dental floss or interdental brushes should be used to clean the spaces between the teeth, where plaque can easily accumulate. Healthy oral hygiene, accompanied by regular visits to the dentist, is the key to preventing tooth decay.
You are what you eat: the right diet to prevent tooth decay

A healthy diet plays a crucial role in preventing tooth decay. This is because a diet high in sugar promotes the growth of bacteria in the mouth that cause tooth decay. To prevent tooth decay, you should limit your sugar intake and focus on a balanced diet with plenty of fresh fruit, vegetables and lean protein. Fluoridated drinking water can also help strengthen teeth and protect them from tooth decay. It is advisable to reduce or avoid sugary drinks and snacks and choose water or other alternatives instead. A healthy diet is an essential part of tooth decay prevention and helps maintain your dental health.
Prevention is key: prophylaxis

Prevention plays a crucial role in preventing tooth decay. Regular check-ups at the dentist are essential for detecting and treating tooth decay at an early stage before the condition leads to serious problems. During these appointments, the dentist will carry out a thorough examination to identify any potential areas of tooth decay. In addition, professional teeth cleaning can be performed to remove plaque and tartar, which reduces the risk of tooth decay. Regular attendance at preventive appointments is an important step in maintaining your dental health and detecting the symptoms of tooth decay in good time.
Caries treatment in children

The treatment of tooth decay in children differs in some respects from the treatment of adults. Since good care and oral hygiene lay the foundation for children’s future dental health, this requires special attention and care. The best method for treating tooth decay in children is to prevent it from the outset. This involves promoting good oral hygiene, educating parents about proper nutrition and using fluoride to strengthen teeth.

Our specially trained pediatric dentists are experts in detecting tooth decay early, often at a very early stage. This allows for timely treatment before the decay can worsen. Our team always strives to create a particularly child-friendly and pleasant environment in our dental practice.
Holistic dentistry at KU64

The KU64 dental practice is a group of dentists covering all areas of dental medicine. From tips on oral hygiene and treating tooth decay to all kinds of fillings, our team of dentists offers sensitivity, precision and highly professional expertise. Whether you need a defective or old filling replaced, are suffering from unexplained toothache or even have isolated black teeth, we at KU64 will help you achieve a healthy and beautiful smile as quickly as possible.
Detect caries quickly after it develops and take action as soon as possible

Caries damage is often underestimated, or the patient does not take their diagnosis seriously because they are not yet experiencing any pain or only mild toothache. At KU64, we are aware of the dangers of caries defects and their consequences, which is why we take immediate action. That is why we thoroughly check even teeth that appear to be intact – this is the only way to detect caries in time, remove it and prevent serious consequences.
The appropriate filling is selected depending on the size of the tooth defect. At the end, you will also receive tips on how to prevent further caries.
Book your appointment now

At our modern dental practice, we offer a wide range of treatments to keep your teeth healthy. Whether you need dental restoration , dentures, root canal treatment , professional teeth cleaning, caries treatment or prophylaxis – KU64 is the right place for you!

Contact our dental specialists today and make an appointment to ask your questions and receive information about our treatments. At KU64, we are your reliable partner in the treatment of tooth decay, and we are here to support you with our expertise and high-quality products.

HOW Quickly Does Tooth Decay Need TO BE Treated?

Once dental disease has been diagnosed, caries should be treated as quickly as possible. This prevents further spread and ensures that dental health is maintained as well as possible. To ensure the earliest possible diagnosis, it is important to watch out for the typical symptoms of caries and contact your dentist immediately.
HOW Painful IS Tooth Decay Treatment?

The amount of pain experienced during caries treatment varies from person to person. The modern dental techniques and anaesthesia methods used in our practice aim to reduce pain during caries treatment to a minimum. Our team at KU64 always strives to make treatment as comfortable as possible for our patients.

The severity of the pain also varies depending on the type of treatment, as more extensive procedures such as root canal treatment can potentially cause more pain than fillings. Talk to us about your concerns and fears; we will be happy to advise you and support you.
HOW Much Does IT Cost TO Remove Tooth Decay?

The cost of treating tooth decay can vary greatly and depends on several factors. First, it is crucial to determine what type of treatment is required. While removing tooth decay and filling a small cavity is relatively inexpensive, the cost of more extensive procedures such as root canal treatment or fitting a crown will be higher. In cases of advanced tooth decay or complications, additional treatments are often necessary, which can increase the overall cost. Of course, you will discuss all available payment options with our team at KU64 in advance before deciding on a treatment.
CAN Cavities BE Removed Without Drilling?

Yes, in some cases, tooth decay can be removed without drilling. There are various minimally invasive treatment methods and techniques that can be used depending on the size and depth of the decay. In most cases, these treatments are preferred as they promote the preservation of healthy tooth substance. Your dentist will recommend the most suitable treatment option after a thorough examination and diagnosis. The following options are available:

Fluoride treatment: Early and therefore more superficial caries lesions can be treated with fluoride-containing gels or varnishes. The fluoride helps to remineralise the tooth enamel and harden the caries lesions.

Caries infiltration: In this method, a special gel is applied to the caries lesion to stop acid formation and remineralise the tooth enamel. This technique is often used for very early and relatively small caries lesions.
CAN A Tooth With Cavities Still BE Saved?

First, the good news: yes! In most cases, a tooth affected by caries can be saved, provided it is detected and treated in time. However, this depends on various factors, such as the extent of the caries and the general condition of the teeth or the affected tooth. The options for saving the tooth include:
Fillings: The diseased area is removed and the hole is filled with a filling.
Dental crowns: If the tooth is already weakened or there is a deeper caries lesion, a dental crown is necessary.
Root canal treatment: If the caries has reached the pulp of the tooth and caused an infection, treatment of the root is necessary.

It is essential to recognise the symptoms of caries in good time in order to save the affected tooth or minimise the consequences of the disease. It is therefore advisable to have regular dental check-ups and to seek medical help immediately if there are signs of caries or dental problems. Your dentist will assess the condition of your tooth and recommend the most appropriate treatment options.

eintraege.h1: Your first visit to KU64 – dental examination in Berlin Charlottenburg

bloecke.text: [ Professional advice on all aspects of your dental health ]

Are you new to Berlin and looking for a dentist? Would you like to change your current dental practice or take advantage of a special service? At KU64 in Berlin, you will find all dental services under one roof. This means that you always have the specialist at your side who can best solve your problem. Whether it’s preventive care or acute complaints such as toothache – during an initial examination, we will advise you on all questions relating to your dental health.
You should have these documents ready for your first visit.

We want everything to run smoothly at your first appointment. In order to provide you with comprehensive advice, we need a few documents when you register. Please bring the following documents with you to your initial examination:
Your insurance card

Your health insurance card proves that you have statutory health insurance. All your personal data is stored on the chip. If you have private health insurance, please bring your identity card with you.
Registration form and questionnaire for risk assessment

Before your first dental examination, we ask you to fill out a registration form. We use the registration and medical history form to record your contact details and information about your general state of health. This includes illnesses, allergies and the use of certain medications that may affect dental treatment. This information enables us to identify risk factors at an early stage and prevent complications. You will receive the registration form from our dental assistants at reception during your first visit.
bonus booklet

Your bonus booklet provides us with an overview of your previous dental check-ups. With your initial examination, you will receive another stamp in your bonus booklet. To fill the bonus booklet completely, you must attend a check-up at least once a year, and children must attend twice a year. If you have not missed a preventive appointment within five to ten years, you will receive a bonus subsidy for dental prostheses from your health insurance company. We take this information into account in your individual cost and treatment plan.
medical records

Have you had X-rays or 3D images, known as DVT images, taken of your teeth in recent years? If so, ask your dentist to provide them to you. Our dentists can take these images into account when assessing your dental health, thus avoiding the need for additional X-rays. Please also bring your X-ray passport with you to the check-up, if you have one.
Treatment and cost plans

Has another dentist already drawn up a treatment and cost plan (HKP) for your treatment? We recommend that you bring this with you to your first dental examination. It contains information about the condition of your teeth, the necessary treatment, the planned therapy and the expected costs, and can serve as a guide for our dentists for further contracts.
Medication passport and heart passport

Please inform us if you are currently taking medication or take medication on a regular basis. A look at your medication passport or the package insert for your medication will help us to assess any undesirable interactions in advance.
implant passport

Do you already have dentures, prostheses or other implants, such as a pacemaker? Please inform us of this and bring your heart passport, if available, with you to your initial examination at our practice.
allergy passport

Are you allergic and have you been given an allergy passport by your doctor? An intact immune system is an important factor, especially when it comes to dental prostheses. With the help of the allergy passport, we can rule out or take into account any contact allergies to dental prosthesis materials in our treatments.
referral

If you have received a referral from your dentist to one of our specialists, please bring it with you to your initial examination. Your dentist will then receive the diagnosis from our examinations afterwards.
Toothbrush

If you don’t have time to brush your teeth beforehand, you can simply do so at our practice before your appointment. Toothbrushes and toothpaste are available for your use. However, if you use a special toothpaste, please remember to bring it with you. Please allow a few extra minutes for brushing your teeth at our practice.
HOW Does THE Initial Examination Work?

During your first visit to our dental practice, no specific treatment will generally be carried out unless you have any complaints. During the initial examination, our dentists will first assess the health of your teeth. They will examine:
Your teeth for plaque, tartar and caries, as well as for fractures, damaged fillings and lack of vitality
Your gums for signs of periodontitis
The condition of your dentures
The position of individual teeth and your tongue
Your jaw joint and chewing muscles for disharmony and misalignment
Your oral mucosa, lips and lymph nodes, as well as
Your throat, face, head and neck for swelling, redness and tissue changes as possible signs of cancer
Individual Consultation ON ALL Dental Services

If further appointments are necessary following the initial examination, we will inform you about your treatment options in a personal consultation. You are welcome to ask questions at any time. In consultation with our colleagues from the fields of implantology, periodontology, oral surgery, orthodontics and cosmetic dentistry, we will then draw up a treatment plan that covers all further steps. This means we can always tell you exactly what we have achieved so far and how long the treatment is likely to take.
Full service under one roof

This guarantees short distances and high quality: we manufacture your dentures in our in-house high-tech dental laboratory. We use all common materials such as CEREC, titanium, gold, plastic and ceramics. On request, our dental technicians will come to your treatment chair to restore your radiant smile permanently by hand.
Preventive Care FOR A Lifelong Smile

Even without subsequent treatment, we recommend that our patients schedule regular check-ups with their dentist after their initial examination. This allows us to detect and treat general diseases at an early stage before they worsen. Poor nutrition, eating disorders, poor oral hygiene, stress or malocclusion can also affect your health in the long term. During your initial examination, we will provide you with specific information and tips for healthy teeth and inform you about prophylaxis and professional teeth cleaning. All of these are ways to not only avoid complex procedures, but also reduce your treatment costs in the long term.
Anxious Patients ARE IN Safe Hands With US

Just the thought of visiting the dentist causes fear and discomfort for many people. That is why we take extra time for our anxious patients. We are delighted that you have found the courage to contact our practice. Patients with dental anxiety can get an appointment at KU64 at very short notice and do not have to wait long. The first appointment is solely for getting to know each other. We are happy to answer your questions in detail and give you our full attention.

We will also accompany you through the treatment. Unpleasant smells and noises can quickly lead to stress even before the treatment begins. We know that. We counteract this with special relaxation techniques, autogenic training or acupressure. To block out the disturbing noises of the dental instruments, we offer you music or audio plays. For longer treatments, you can watch a film with video glasses. We divide the treatment itself into small steps. This ensures sufficient breaks during which we can explain the next step to you.

We promise you: pain during dental visits is a thing of the past at KU64 Berlin. In our practice, we have many years of experience with sedatives and tranquillisers. On request, we can also carry out your treatment under general anaesthesia.
Our opening hours – as flexible as your everyday life

Want to relax at the dentist during your free time? No problem. We have adapted our opening hours to the needs of our patients. eintraege.h1: Pain-free laser dental treatment for healthy gums – KU64 Berlin Your dentist for laser treatment of periodontitis

bloecke.text: Thanks to modern laser therapy, dental treatments today can be performed with little to no pain. This method has proven especially effective in the treatment of periodontitis: The dental hygienists at KU64 Berlin use ultra-fine dental lasers for particularly precise and gentle procedures. Unpleasant drilling noises and vibrations are a thing of the past. As a patient, you benefit from reduced bleeding and swelling, as well as faster wound healing.
Laser Instead of Scraping: Healthier Gums Through the Power of Light

Lasers are increasingly being used in modern dentistry and have, in many cases, partially or even fully replaced scalpels and drills. Simply put, laser beams are highly concentrated, high-energy light. During treatment, these ultra-short pulses of light target the tissue and are converted into heat. Depending on the intensity and speed of the light pulses, different effects can be achieved.

The advantages: Laser beams can reach areas in the mouth that are difficult or even impossible for a dental hygienist to access with conventional instruments. In addition, lasers allow for highly precise treatment – diseased tissue can be targeted without damaging the surrounding healthy tissue.

Laser treatment can also help reduce bacteria and germs in the oral cavity, and cauterize blood vessels. Depending on the laser type, the treated area may also be cooled during the procedure. Swelling and bleeding are usually significantly reduced after laser treatment.

In the past, we also used lasers for cavity treatment and surgical procedures. However, over time, other techniques have proven to be more effective and gentler. That’s why KU64 now consciously relies on more modern and well-established methods instead of lasers in those specific areas.
Laser Treatment Areas
Laser technology has become an indispensable part of many areas of dentistry. At KU64 Berlin, lasers are used in the following treatments:
Periodontology: Laser treatment for periodontitis
Revolutionary Intensive Dental Cleaning “Prophylaxis PLUS Laser” at KU64 BERLIN-MITTE: The Future of Oral Care

Experience the next generation of intensive dental cleaning at KU64 BERLIN-MITTE! Our innovative method combines in-depth theoretical training with practical expertise – professionally carried out by our dental hygienists and laser specialists Adina Mauder and Aisegkioul Netzip Oglou-Housein at our Ku’damm location, and by our experienced prophylaxis assistant Nurcan Sahin at the KU64 practice in Berlin-Mitte.

At the core of this approach is an advanced laser treatment that specifically reduces bacterial load in the mouth – without the side effects of conventional antibiotics. Whether laser treatment is recommended is determined individually using the MMP8 test. This test measures specific enzymes that indicate inflammatory processes and may compromise the natural barrier function of your oral mucosa.

Treatment begins with a standard professional dental cleaning (PDC), including pocket depth measurements. If probing depths of 3–4 mm with bleeding are detected along with an elevated MMP8 value, we recommend our „Prophylaxis PLUS Laser" treatment as a targeted supportive measure.
This innovative therapy includes:
effective elimination of inflammation-causing bacteria with a gentle laser beam,
sustainable strengthening of the oral microbiome using probiotic lozenges,
targeted restoration of beneficial bacteria.
In addition, laser therapy is also successfully used in the treatment of peri-implantitis .
Peri-implantitis is a serious inflammation around a dental implant – similar to periodontitis, but often even more persistent. At KU64, we address this challenge using cutting-edge laser technology.

What makes laser therapy so special? Instead of conventional surgical methods, we use a precise, state-of-the-art laser. It penetrates the inflamed tissue, reduces bacterial load, and simultaneously promotes healing – without scalpels and with minimal discomfort. The laser works like a “modern antibiotic without side effects.”
An Overview of All the Benefits of Laser Treatment for Patients
Laser treatment for periodontitis is one of the most innovative and gentle methods in modern dentistry. Our patients benefit from the following advantages:
precise and careful treatment that preserves healthy tissue
little to no need for local anesthesia due to minimal discomfort
long-term reduction of bacteria and germs in the mouth, helping to minimize inflammation
significantly less need for antibiotics or medications after treatment
reduced swelling and bleeding thanks to simultaneous cauterization of blood vessels
non-invasive procedure with no stitches or scarring
contact-free treatment with no vibrations or drilling noise
shorter treatment time and virtually no tooth pain
quick and uncomplicated healing process
aesthetically pleasing results
eating and drinking is possible immediately after treatment
Costs for Laser Dental Treatment at KU64 Berlin

The cost of laser treatment varies depending on the type of procedure. The number of teeth being treated is a key factor. The dental hygienists at KU64 will be happy to explain each step in detail and provide you with a personalized cost estimate tailored to your treatment plan.

Laser treatments are not part of standard statutory health insurance benefits and are therefore not reimbursed by public health insurance providers. As a patient, you are responsible for covering the cost of your laser treatment yourself. In acute cases, pregnant and breastfeeding women may be eligible for reimbursement of laser treatment costs under certain conditions.

The procedure is painless , effective , and can be repeated if necessary. When combined with professional dental cleaning, it typically takes around 2 hours , and the cost ranges between €700 and €800 .

In our daily practice, we see that many patients are reluctant to visit the dentist due to a fear of pain. Sounds, vibrations, and smells during treatment often intensify dental anxiety.

The use of laser technology can help patients overcome this fear. The new experience of a pain-free treatment without unpleasant noises or pressure sensations can break existing fear patterns and take away the basis of dental anxiety.
With laser technology, we offer our patients a gentle and highly effective periodontal treatment with the best possible outcomes.

In medicine, a distinction is made between hard lasers, soft lasers, and MID lasers. Hard lasers have a high power output and are primarily used for cutting and removing tissue. They are applied in root canal treatments as well as in the therapy of periodontitis.

Soft lasers, on the other hand, operate at lower power levels and do not generate heat during treatment. Because of their low intensity, they are used to activate tissue. This stimulation helps reduce pain and inflammation during treatment and promotes blood circulation.
MID lasers operate at a medium power level but achieve similar effects to those of soft lasers.
At the KU64 dental practice in Berlin, we use the A.R.C. Laser for our treatments. This is a diode laser (soft laser) that has been available on the German market since 1981.
[Prevent tooth decay thanks to professional caries risk assessment by KU64]

Many people only go to the dentist when they have toothache or discover black spots on their teeth themselves! Most people are unaware that it is possible to have a caries risk assessment carried out as part of preventive care, thereby protecting their teeth from caries and keeping them healthy in the long term. The test is very simple, completely painless, provides reliable warning of caries and is quick.
How KU64's risk assessment works

Our dentists at KU64 simply take a saliva sample from you. Using this sample, our specialists can identify acid-producing bacteria and mutans streptococci (lactobacilli) and give you an assessment of how susceptible your teeth are to harmful bacteria. You are at increased risk if you already have old or defective fillings in your mouth. You are also at high risk from harmful bacteria if you already have plaque, as this is a breeding ground for bacteria.
We at KU64 have the right tools to help you

If the caries risk assessment shows that you are at risk, we can give you the right advice to avoid complex (and costly) treatments. We are happy to give you a few easy-to-follow tips on oral hygiene and nutrition. If this is not enough, we also recommend using a tongue brush and an ultrasonic toothbrush to optimise your daily oral care. Both care products have shown very good results, especially in removing critical and stubborn plaque. Take precautions in good time and prevent the worst from happening.

Frequently Asked Questions About Aesthetic Medicine
What is aesthetic medicine?

Aesthetic medicine includes medical treatments aimed at improving or correcting your appearance – without the need for surgery. It focuses on gentle, minimally invasive procedures for skin rejuvenation, wrinkle reduction, and facial harmonization.
Typical treatments in aesthetic medicine include:
Wrinkle treatments to gently smooth facial lines
Lip augmentation for more volume and definition
Laser therapy for skin rejuvenation and removal of pigmentation or scarring
Unlike plastic surgery, aesthetic medicine requires no surgical procedures – like rhinoplasty, liposuction, or breast augmentation – and achieves natural-looking results with short recovery times.
What is Aesthetic Dermatology?

Aesthetic dermatology is a subfield of dermatology that focuses on enhancing and rejuvenating the skin. It combines medical skincare with modern, minimally invasive procedures to improve skin texture, tone, and elasticity. The main goal is to maintain healthy, aesthetically pleasing skin – usually without surgical intervention.
Treatments in aesthetic dermatology may include laser therapy, medical-grade peels, microneedling, or PRP (platelet-rich plasma) therapy.
What’s the Difference Between Aesthetic Medicine and Plastic Surgery?
The difference between aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery lies mainly in the techniques used, the level of invasiveness, and the purpose of the procedure.
Aesthetic medicine includes non-surgical treatments aimed at improving one’s appearance. These treatments focus on reducing wrinkles, refining facial contours, or enhancing skin texture.

Plastic surgery , by contrast, involves surgical procedures that permanently alter deeper tissue layers or structures. Typical examples include liposuction, rhinoplasty, or breast augmentation. Such procedures may be done for cosmetic or reconstructive reasons, e.g., after an accident.

Invasive procedures are typically performed under general anesthesia in a clinic setting. Those choosing plastic surgery should expect longer recovery and healing times. As with any surgery, a detailed consultation with your physician about potential risks is essential.
What Kind of Training Does a Doctor in Aesthetic Medicine Have?

As of January 2025, there is no officially recognized medical specialty for aesthetic medicine. Physicians typically complete general medical training followed by advanced continuing education in non-surgical aesthetic procedures.

Unlike plastic surgeons, who complete formal residency programs in plastic and aesthetic surgery, there is no standardized training path in aesthetic medicine. A completed medical degree and licensure are the basic requirements. Many practitioners in this field also hold board certifications in dermatology, plastic surgery, oral surgery, or other medical specialties. To perform aesthetic procedures, physicians must qualify through additional training beyond licensure.
All our specialists at KU64 Berlin pursue regular continuing education and bring expert knowledge in their field – so you can always rely on top-quality treatments and results.
Are Aesthetic Treatments Covered by Health Insurance?

Aesthetic treatments and plastic surgery procedures are generally considered cosmetic and are not covered by statutory health insurance, as they are not deemed medically necessary. This means the costs are typically borne by the patient.
However, there are exceptions where public or private health insurance may cover the costs of an aesthetic procedure. These include:
Medically necessary reconstructive treatments following accidents or illness
Documented psychological distress confirmed by a medical evaluation
Functional or health impairments, e.g., severely drooping eyelids affecting vision

Purely cosmetic treatments such as wrinkle reduction , lip augmentation , or skin rejuvenation are not covered by statutory health insurance. Some private health insurance plans may cover certain treatments. If you’re privately insured, consult your provider about which costs might be reimbursed and which documentation is required.

Interested in an aesthetic facial treatment? At KU64 Berlin, we’re happy to provide you with a detailed cost estimate including all relevant information, so you can make an informed decision about which treatments are right for you.
Which Areas Can Be Treated With Aesthetic Medicine?
Aesthetic medicine is suitable for various areas of the face and body. It typically focuses on harmonizing facial features and correcting minor imperfections.

Wrinkle treatments are often performed on the forehead and around the eyes. In the lip area , volume can be restored or contours refined. Other common treatment zones include the neck, décolleté, and hands – as well as body areas affected by cellulite, pigmentation, or skin irregularities.
[ Naturally full lips and smooth skin with KU64 in Berlin ]

Full, well-shaped lips, firm skin, and defined facial features are key to attractiveness and youthfulness. They give the face expression and harmony – but with age, lip volume can decrease, skin becomes less firm and tight, and contours around the cheeks, chin, and nose start to fade.

This is where hyaluronic fillers come into play: a minimally invasive and safe method to smooth fine lines, gently plump the lips, and create a harmonious overall appearance. Hyaluronic acid can be precisely dosed and delivers natural, aesthetic results.

As a specialist for beauty treatments in Berlin, KU64 stands for premium quality and the most advanced techniques. Our experienced team combines medical precision with a strong sense for aesthetics – to deliver balanced, long-lasting results. Let us advise you personally and find out how a hyaluronic acid lip filler can enhance your natural beauty.
What IS Hyaluronic Acid?

Hyaluronic acid is a true all-rounder when it comes to skin beauty and health. As a natural component of the body, it plays a crucial role in moisture retention, elasticity, and volume. Especially in the lip area, hyaluron has proven to be a gentle and effective method to add volume, define contours, and reduce dryness. So what exactly makes hyaluronic acid so special?
Hyaluronic Acid – A Natural Component OF THE Skin

Hyaluron is a substance produced by the body that can bind large amounts of water – up to 6,000 times its own weight. In the skin, it provides firmness, hydration, and smoothness. However, with age, the skin’s natural hyaluronic acid levels decline, leading to volume loss, dryness, and fine lines.
Crosslinked AND Non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid
For aesthetic treatments, both crosslinked and non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid are used. These two forms differ in structure, durability, and their benefits for various applications.
Crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid: Volume AND Targeted Correction

This form of hyaluronic acid is stabilized through chemical processes, giving the molecules a firmer, gel-like structure. As a result, it breaks down more slowly and remains in the tissue longer. It is mainly used for the following treatments:
Wrinkle filling (e.g. nasolabial folds, marionette lines)
Lip injections and contour definition
Cheek and chin augmentation
Nose correction
Deep wrinkle treatment and volume enhancement

Because crosslinked hyaluronic acid is firmer, it is especially suitable for areas where structure, volume, and long-lasting effects are desired. Depending on the product and individual metabolism, results can last between 6 and 18 months.
Non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid: Hydration FOR Radiant Skin
This form is more fluid and breaks down more quickly as it is not chemically stabilized. It mainly provides hydration and improves skin structure without adding volume. It is used for:
Skin booster treatments for skin rejuvenation
Hydrating mesotherapy for face, neck, and décolleté
Reduction of fine lines (e.g. around the eyes or neck)
Non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid is often applied in multiple sessions to sustainably improve skin quality. Because it is broken down more quickly, results typically last 3 to 6 months.
Benefits OF Hyaluronic Fillers FOR Lips AND Skin
Injecting hyaluronic acid is one of the safest and most popular methods in aesthetic medicine. The benefits are clear:
Natural, personalized results: Tailored dosage and treatment for exactly the outcome you’re aiming for.
Hydration and smoothness: Dry or chapped lips become soft and plump again. Tired skin looks refreshed and radiant.
Minimally invasive with immediate effect: The treatment takes only about 20–30 minutes – and results can be seen right away.
Want to learn more about hyaluronic acid lip filler treatments for lips and face at KU64 in Berlin? Get expert advice from our experienced team!
Treatment With Hyaluronic Acid
At KU64 in Berlin, we place great value on personal consultation and tailored treatments to ensure results that meet your expectations 100 percent.
1. Consultation & Analysis
In a detailed consultation, we discuss your needs and goals and analyze your individual facial features. Together, we determine which lip shape, cheek or nose correction best suits you.
2. Preparation
The treatment area is thoroughly disinfected. If desired, your doctor can apply a numbing cream to make the procedure even more comfortable.
3. Injection OF Hyaluronic Acid
Using a precise injection technique, the filler is administered to create a harmonious shape and restore natural volume to the target area.
4. Aftercare
After the treatment, our specialists will explain how to support the healing process and achieve the best possible result. Mild swelling or redness usually subsides within 24 to 48 hours.
Good to know: Initial results are visible right after a hyaluronic acid lip filler treatment. The final result appears after 3–5 days.
When IS A Hyaluronic Acid Treatment Suitable?
Hyaluronic fillers are a popular and proven method to enhance lip and facial contours, plump the skin, and restore moisture.
Thin or asymmetrical lips: Precise injection techniques can harmonize lip shape and restore balance.
Age-related volume loss in the lips: Hyaluronic acid gently restores volume and creates a fuller, more youthful look.
Nasolabial folds or under-eye wrinkles: The plumping effect of hyaluronic acid also softens deeper wrinkles.
Nose correction: Targeted injections can correct irregularities and create a more symmetrical shape.
Cheek and chin augmentation: Loss of firmness in these areas can be gently corrected, enhancing facial definition.
Whether you’re seeking a subtle skin refresh or fuller lips and defined contours, KU64 in Berlin offers individualized treatments tailored to your natural features.
When IS A Hyaluronic Acid Treatment NOT Recommended?
In some cases, wrinkle injections or lip augmentation with hyaluronic acid may not be advisable and should be postponed to minimize risk:
Acute infections or inflammation: In case of herpes, wounds, or skin irritation, treatment should only be done after full recovery.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding: Aesthetic procedures like hyaluronic fillers are not recommended during these sensitive phases due to a lack of safety studies.
Allergies or intolerances to hyaluronic acid: Individuals with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or its additives should opt for alternative treatments.
Results OF A Hyaluronic Acid Treatment

The effect of a hyaluronic acid treatment is not permanent, as the injected substance is gradually broken down by the body. On average, the result lasts between 6 and 12 months – depending on the treatment area and factors like metabolism and lifestyle. If you want to maintain lip volume or the defined contours of your chin or cheeks, a refresh session can easily be scheduled.

Right after the injection, the treated area may swell slightly – this is completely normal and typically subsides within a few hours to days. The final result is visible after around 3 to 5 days, once the filler is fully settled and any swelling has resolved.
Possible Temporary Side Effects
Mild swelling & redness: Can occur immediately after the injection, usually subsiding within 24 to 48 hours.
Bruising: Small hematomas or bruises at the injection sites may appear but usually fade within a few days.
Asymmetry: In rare cases, slight unevenness can occur and may be corrected with a follow-up treatment.
Proper Aftercare FOR Hyaluronic Treatment
Avoid pressure: In the first days post-treatment, avoid applying pressure to the treated area to allow the filler to settle evenly.
Stay hydrated: Hyaluronic acid binds moisture – sufficient fluid intake supports the results and keeps skin and lips supple.
Gentle cooling: If swelling occurs, gently cool the area with a soft cold pad to support healing.
Moderate temperatures: Avoid saunas, tanning beds, or strong cooling (e.g., ice packs), as extreme temperatures may impair healing.
With the right aftercare, results can be optimized and longevity extended.
NO Need TO Fear “duckface”: Technique Makes ALL THE Difference

Many patients hesitate to get lip fillers because they fear an unnatural „duckface" look. This exaggerated, uneven appearance is usually the result of poor injection technique or overuse of hyaluronic acid.

At KU64 in Berlin, we focus on natural, harmonious results – whether it’s lip augmentation, nose correction, or wrinkle treatment. Our experienced doctors use precise techniques to gently shape the lips, maintaining the natural proportions of the face. By applying lip fillers in moderate amounts, we subtly enhance your lips while preserving a natural look that suits your individual facial features.

Safe & gentle treatment methods At our Berlin practice on Kurfürstendamm, we use high-quality hyaluronic fillers that deliver natural-looking results and are fully broken down by the body within 6–12 months.

Frequently Asked Questions About Hyaluronic Acid Treatments
How long does a treatment with hyaluronic acid take?

Depending on whether you’re treating wrinkles, getting a hyaluronic acid lip filler, correcting the nose, or enhancing other facial areas, treatment usually takes 20 to 40 minutes. Thanks to modern techniques and, if needed, local anesthesia, the procedure is virtually painless and you can return to your daily routine right after. Initial results are visible immediately after the injection; the final outcome becomes apparent after 3 to 5 days once any swelling has subsided.
How much hyaluronic acid is used during treatment?

The amount depends on the area being treated and your desired result. For subtle lip enhancements, fine lines, or gentle contour corrections, we typically start with a smaller amount and can adjust if needed. Our experienced specialists ensure a natural appearance and harmonious proportions tailored to your facial features.
Typical guideline values: • Lip filler: 0.5 – 1 ml • Cheek enhancement: 1 – 3 ml • Chin contouring: 1 – 2 ml • Nose correction: 0.5 – 1 ml • Wrinkle treatment: 0.5 – 1 ml per area
We always determine the exact amount during your personal consultation.
Is hyaluronic acid treatment painful?

Generally, hyaluronic acid lip fillers are only minimally uncomfortable. Most patients feel a slight prick or pressure at the injection site. Very fine needles are used to minimize discomfort. For sensitive areas like the lips, we apply a numbing cream beforehand.
Mild redness or tightness after the procedure is normal and usually subsides within a few hours. Overall, the injection is a quick, low-risk, and nearly pain-free aesthetic treatment.
Can I return to work immediately after my hyaluronic acid treatment?

Yes – you can typically resume work and your usual daily activities right after. Minor swelling, redness, or small bruises at the injection sites may occur but usually fade within 24 to 48 hours. To maintain optimal results, we recommend avoiding strenuous activity, hot drinks, and visits to saunas or tanning beds during the first 24 hours. If mild swelling occurs, gently cooling with a soft pad can help.
Can I wear lipstick after getting lip fillers?

After a hyaluronic acid lip filler, you should avoid wearing lipstick or gloss for at least 24 hours. The lips are more sensitive immediately after the procedure, and makeup products may cause irritation or infection. We recommend gently caring for your lips using fragrance-free moisturizers. Once the initial healing phase is complete and there’s no redness or swelling, you can apply makeup as usual.
Can I exercise after a hyaluronic acid treatment?

Avoid physical activity and sports for at least 24 to 48 hours after your hyaluronic acid injection. Increased blood flow during workouts can intensify swelling, bruising, or uneven filler distribution. Once healing is complete after a few days, you can resume your regular fitness routine.
How long do lip fillers last?
Hyaluronic acid lip fillers typically last 6 to 12 months. Since the body naturally breaks down hyaluronic acid, regular touch-ups can help maintain the desired volume and lip shape long term.

For those with a fast metabolism or expressive facial muscles, the filler may be broken down faster. Others may retain results longer. For personalized advice on the best treatment intervals, our KU64 Berlin experts are happy to help.
Which lip fillers are the best?
There are several methods to enhance lip volume and contour. The ideal method depends on your goals and natural lip shape.

Hyaluronic acid fillers: The most popular lip fillers – they hydrate, add volume, and can precisely define lip contours. Botulinum toxin: This method relaxes the muscles around the lips, creating the appearance of fuller lips without direct augmentation. Fat transfer: Fat is taken from another area of your body and injected into the lips – results last longer than hyaluronic acid but the method is more invasive. Thread lifting: Fine threads are inserted to gently lift and define the lips. Ideal for those who want firmer contours rather than extra volume.
Is a hyaluronic acid treatment safe?
Yes. Hyaluronic acid is a natural substance in the body that retains moisture and skin elasticity. Since it’s biodegradable, injected hyaluronic acid is naturally broken down within 6 to 12 months.

Modern fillers are developed specifically for aesthetic purposes. They’re typically free from animal ingredients and allergens, making side effects rare. At KU64 in Berlin, we only use certified, high-quality hyaluronic acid products and tailor treatments to each patient’s individual needs – always performed by experienced professionals.
At what age can you get lip fillers?
In general, hyaluronic acid lip fillers are permitted from the age of 18. Younger patients may undergo treatment only with written parental or guardian consent.

Before every procedure, we provide a personal consultation – not only to understand your expectations and wishes, but also to determine whether the treatment is appropriate and justifiable in your individual case.
At KU64 in Berlin, we place great emphasis on safe, professional treatments that deliver natural and harmonious results aligned with your personal aesthetic.
How much do hyaluronic acid injections cost?

The cost of hyaluronic acid injections varies depending on the treatment area and the amount of filler required to achieve your desired result. Prices for 1 ml of hyaluronic acid generally range between €180 and €290:
Lip enhancement: €180 – €290
Nasolabial folds: €180 – €290
Cheek and chin contouring: €180 – €290
Nose correction: €180 – €290
Under-eye lines (1.5 ml): from €249
We determine the exact cost of your treatment during a personal consultation, where we take the time to understand your individual needs and expectations. Feel free to book your appointment today!

eintraege.h1: Wrinkle Treatment IN Berlin AT KU64

bloecke.text: Do you know the feeling? You feel fresh, youthful, and full of energy – but at a certain age, the reflection in the mirror tells a different story. Fine lines on the forehead, laugh lines around the eyes, or wrinkles at the corners of the mouth often make us look more tired and drained. Would you like to look just as refreshed as you feel? Then KU64 in Berlin is the right place for you.

At our practice on Kurfürstendamm, Dr. Dr. Matthias Leyh and his team – specialists in aesthetics and oral, maxillofacial, and facial surgery – combine medical aesthetics with gentle wrinkle treatment methods. From gentle injections with hyaluronic acid or muscle relaxants to innovative filler and lifting techniques – together we’ll find the best wrinkle treatment for your individual needs. Visit us for a personal consultation and take the first step towards a younger, fresher appearance and boosted self-confidence!
What Wrinkle Treatment Methods ARE Available?

Aesthetic medicine offers many options for smoothing wrinkles and rejuvenating the skin – all without surgery. Depending on age, skin condition, and the desired result, different methods such as wrinkle injections or tightening procedures may be suitable. Which wrinkle treatment is best for you depends on your individual needs and physical conditions.
Our specialists will gladly advise you in detail to find the optimal solution for you.
Wrinkle Treatment with Botulinum Toxin

Our facial expressions make our faces lively and unique – but over time, life leaves behind forehead lines, frown lines, or crow’s feet. Wrinkle treatment with botulinum toxin, also known as Botox, targets exactly that: Through precise injections of this muscle relaxant, certain facial muscles can be gently relaxed. This smooths existing wrinkles and helps prevent new ones from forming.

The treatment takes only a few minutes and delivers fast results. Especially for deep expression lines, botulinum toxin is a proven method to reduce them gently. Our goal is a natural, aesthetic result based on your individual wishes. We always tailor the dosage precisely to your needs following a personal consultation.
[More on botulinum toxin treatments at KU64]
Wrinkle Treatment with Hyaluronic Acid

As we age, our skin loses moisture and elasticity, making it look less fresh and more prone to wrinkles. Wrinkle injections with a filler like hyaluronic acid can help restore lost volume and smooth fine lines. This method is especially popular for treating nasolabial folds, marionette lines, and lip lines. It’s also ideal for gently shaping the lips, cheeks, or chin.

Hyaluronic acid is a natural substance found in the body and is well tolerated by the skin. The injection is minimally invasive, meaning you can enjoy visible results quickly – without any downtime in your professional or personal life. Combined with other aesthetic procedures such as thread lifting, hyaluronic acid ensures harmonious, natural-looking results.
[More on hyaluronic acid treatments at KU64]
Mesotherapy

Many patients want more than just wrinkle treatment – they want their skin to look radiant and refreshed overall. For this, the skin needs more moisture, nutrients, and improved regenerative capacity.

Mesotherapy is an innovative method designed for just that: Using ultra-fine injections, individually selected active ingredients such as hyaluronic acid, vitamins, and antioxidants are delivered directly into the skin. This stimulates cell regeneration, firms the tissue, and revitalizes your skin.
This aesthetic treatment is especially suitable for fine dry lines and tired, dull skin. It can be applied to the face as well as the neck, décolleté, or hands.
Our doctors tailor the combination of active ingredients to your skin’s specific needs after a thorough consultation – to give you the glowing result you’re looking for.
Collagen Booster

Collagen is a key structural protein that gives skin firmness and elasticity. As we age, the body’s natural collagen production slows, the skin loses tension, and wrinkles form. Collagen boosters aim to slow this process and stimulate your skin’s natural regeneration.

Injections with special active ingredients like polylactic acid or calcium hydroxyapatite stimulate long-term collagen production. The result: gradual firming and a naturally lifted appearance that sustainably improves your skin quality. This method is particularly effective for deeper wrinkles, sunken cheeks, or sagging areas.
Thread Lifting

Your skin has lost its firmness and you’re looking for a natural lift without surgery? Thread lifting is a gentle alternative to plastic surgery. This method uses threads that are placed under the skin to create an immediate tightening effect. At the same time, they stimulate collagen production, improving your skin texture over the weeks and months to follow. The threads are resorbable – meaning they dissolve over time and don’t need to be removed.
Thread lifting is especially suited for treating sagging or drooping skin on the cheeks as well as mild wrinkles on the chin, neck, or décolleté.
PRP Treatment
PRP treatment, also known as Vampire Lifting, is an innovative method to make your skin look fresh and radiant – without artificial additives.

Instead of synthetic fillers, this treatment uses your own blood. The processed PRP (platelet-rich plasma) is rich in thrombocytes, which stimulate your body’s own collagen and cell production and support your skin’s natural regeneration.

This aesthetic method is ideal for tired, dull skin, first signs of wrinkles, or overall skin quality improvement in the face, neck, and décolleté. PRP wrinkle treatment can also be combined with other procedures like injections or thread lifting to enhance skin tightening.
Wrinkle Treatment with Chemical Peels
Chemical peels are a proven method to counteract skin aging, sun damage, and environmental stress – and to give your skin a refreshed, even, and radiant glow.

By applying special acids – such as fruit acid, trichloroacetic acid (TCA), or salicylic acid – dead skin cells are gently removed from the surface and deep within the pores. At the same time, new cell formation is stimulated and collagen production is encouraged. Depending on intensity, a chemical peel can act on the surface or reach deeper skin layers.
Microdermabrasion

Many people find unevenness, fine wrinkles, or acne scars bothersome. Dermabrasion is an effective aesthetic method to correct such surface-level flaws. During dermabrasion, the top skin layer is precisely removed, stimulating skin renewal. Fine rotating heads gently smooth your skin, while pigmentation issues are balanced and wrinkles reduced.
This treatment is ideal if you want visible skin rejuvenation but prefer to avoid fillers, injections, or thread lifting – and want to support natural regeneration.
Carboxytherapy

As we age, skin blood flow slows, leading to reduced oxygen supply and loss of skin firmness. Carboxytherapy counters this process: By injecting medical carbon dioxide (CO₂) into the skin, blood flow is stimulated, oxygen supply is improved, and the body’s own collagen production is activated.

This treatment is an option if you want to reduce fine lines or dark circles or tighten sagging skin on the face, neck, and décolleté. Improved skin regeneration from carboxytherapy may also help with stretch marks and scars.
Laser Therapy

Similar to collagen or PRP treatments, laser therapy aims to stimulate the skin’s natural regeneration and give it a more even, refreshed appearance. With modern laser technology, deep skin layers can be targeted and collagen production enhanced.
Laser therapy is suitable for treating the face, neck, and décolleté. Its precision also allows for targeted treatment of fine lines, scars, or irregular skin texture on various body areas.
Beautiful ALL Around: Areas Where YOU CAN GET Wrinkle Treatments

Wrinkles typically appear where the skin is heavily stressed by facial expressions, sun exposure, or the natural aging process. While some lines can give your face character, deeper wrinkles may make you look tired or tense.

Whether you’re considering wrinkle treatment for your face or another part of your body, KU64 in Berlin offers a range of modern aesthetic procedures designed to gently smooth, tighten, and regenerate your skin. We always place great importance on tailoring your wrinkle treatment to your individual needs and wishes—aiming for results that enhance your natural appearance.
We’ll be happy to advise you on which method suits you best. Go ahead and book an appointment!
For most people, the first wrinkles appear on the forehead. They are mainly caused by facial expressions, UV radiation from sunlight, and the natural loss of skin elasticity with age.

If you’d like to reduce forehead lines, there are several options available. A well-established and popular method is targeted wrinkle treatment using botulinum toxin (Botox) . This muscle relaxant reduces the activity of the forehead muscles, softening existing lines and helping prevent new ones. For deeper wrinkles, a combination with hyaluronic acid can help restore lost volume.

Frown lines, also known as glabellar lines, form between the eyebrows and can make your face look tense or stern – even when you’re fully relaxed. These vertical lines develop from repeated muscle contractions in the forehead, for example when focusing or reacting to bright light.

As with forehead lines, a targeted injection of botulinum toxin is the most effective method to reduce frown lines. If the line is particularly deep, a treatment with hyaluronic acid may be useful to gently plump up the area.

The fine lines at the corners of the eyes – commonly known as crow’s feet – develop over the years through smiling and blinking. The skin around the eyes is especially delicate and loses firmness more quickly with age, allowing wrinkles to form and deepen more easily.

If you’d like a gentle smoothing of crow’s feet to give your eyes a fresher, more open appearance, you can opt for a targeted injection with botulinum toxin or hyaluronic acid . PRP wrinkle treatment (using your own blood plasma) is also a good option, especially if you prefer a treatment with natural, body-derived substances and your crow’s feet are still in an early stage.

Marionette lines run downward from the corners of the mouth to the chin and can make you look moody or sad. As skin loses elasticity and volume with age, these lines deepen. Smoking can also accelerate their development.
To plump up marionette lines, injections with hyaluronic acid are a proven and effective option. Alternatively, autologous fat (your own fat) can be used for longer-lasting results.
If you also want to lift the sagging skin around the corners of your mouth, a thread lift may be a helpful addition – restoring the beauty of your smile just as you imagine it.

Nasolabial folds run from the sides of the nose to the corners of the mouth and are among the most prominent facial wrinkles. They deepen with age due to loss of skin elasticity and volume, as well as frequent smiling and speaking.

As with marionette lines, hyaluronic acid injections are a proven treatment to gently add volume. In some cases, autologous fat may also be used to restore lost volume between the nose and mouth for long-lasting results.

For more comprehensive lifting, a thread lift or collagen booster may also be suitable. We’ll be happy to advise you on all available options and help you find the most effective wrinkle treatment for your personal needs.
Also known as „bunny lines," nose wrinkles are fine lines that appear on the sides of the nose, especially when you laugh or scrunch your nose.

If these lines bother you, botulinum toxin injections can help smooth them and prevent new ones from forming. For deeper lines, additional hyaluronic acid injections can help plump the area and improve overall skin texture.

You have fine lines around your mouth that make you look older? Lip lines, also called smoker’s lines or pleated wrinkles, can be reduced with various methods – while also naturally enhancing the shape of your lips.

Hyaluronic acid wrinkle treatment smooths and improves the skin in the lip area while restoring volume. If you’d like to achieve an even more youthful smile, the treatment can be combined with a collagen booster or laser therapy , which strengthens the structure of your lips over time.
As you age, fine lines – and eventually deeper wrinkles – can appear on the chin. These often go hand in hand with uneven surface texture.

To smooth chin wrinkles, many patients choose botulinum toxin injections . If the focus is on restoring volume and contour, hyaluronic acid or autologous fat can help create a more harmonious appearance. For deeper lifting and definition, a thread lift or collagen booster can be a helpful addition.

Along with the forehead, the neck is often one of the first areas where signs of aging become visible. As collagen production decreases, fine lines or deeper transverse wrinkles appear that can impact the overall contour of your neck.

To firm and rejuvenate the neck area, several treatment options are available. Fine lines can be treated with hyaluronic acid injections . For deeper wrinkles or sagging skin, a thread lift or collagen booster can stimulate the body’s own regeneration and provide long-lasting lifting results.

The décolleté is a sensitive area often exposed to sunlight and therefore loses elasticity relatively quickly. Wrinkles in this area can result from aging, repeated movements during sleep, or insufficient skincare.

A proven method to smooth and revitalize the décolleté is hyaluronic acid injection . This treatment adds moisture, improves skin structure, and reduces fine wrinkles. For deeper regeneration, a PRP treatment or mesotherapy can help stimulate collagen production and strengthen the skin structure.
What ARE THE Risks OF A Wrinkle Treatment?

As with any medical treatment, wrinkle injections and other non- or minimally invasive methods come with certain risks, which may vary depending on your skin type and the technique used. In most cases, modern aesthetic treatments are safe and well-tolerated when performed by experienced professionals. Right after the procedure, minor side effects like redness, swelling or small bruises may occur – but typically fade quickly.

With injections using hyaluronic acid , autologous fat , or botulinum toxin , rare side effects may include asymmetry or allergic reactions. Thread lifting and collagen boosters carry a small risk of infection or temporary irregularities in skin texture. UNLIKE SURGICAL PROCEDURES like liposuction or tummy tucks, the risks involved in gentle skin rejuvenation methods of aesthetic medicine are minimal. At our practice on Kurfürstendamm in Berlin, we take time before each treatment to discuss all potential risks with you in detail.
Everyday Anti-aging: HOW TO Prevent Wrinkles

Wrinkles develop naturally over time – a process that affects us all. In addition to genetics, your individual lifestyle and environmental factors play a key role in how early and how visibly signs of aging appear.
By taking proactive steps, you can slow down the skin’s aging process and keep your skin firmer and fresher for longer.
Balanced Diet AND Plenty OF Fluids

Antioxidants, vitamins, and unsaturated fatty acids support collagen production and protect your skin from premature wrinkles. Omega-3 fatty acids in particular—found in fish, nuts, and avocados—help improve skin elasticity. Vitamin C (e.g. in citrus fruits or bell peppers) and vitamin E (present in leafy greens and plant oils) shield your skin from harmful free radicals. With the right diet, you can do a great deal to keep your skin healthy and youthful for longer.

Sufficient fluid intake is also essential: water helps flush toxins from the body and keeps the skin hydrated. Dehydration, on the other hand, can cause your skin to appear dull and make fine lines more visible.
Avoiding Smoking AND Alcohol
Smoking and alcohol consumption impair the supply of oxygen and nutrients to the skin—making them among the biggest accelerators of skin aging.

Smoking damages collagen and elastin fibers, which are essential for firm skin. Smokers often develop pronounced lip lines and deeper wrinkles around the mouth and eyes. Even aesthetic treatments like wrinkle injections or collagen boosters can only partially counteract the effects of smoking.

Alcohol dehydrates the body and strips the skin of essential nutrients. This results in reduced firmness, making fine lines more prominent. Long-term alcohol consumption may also cause redness, broken capillaries, and uneven skin texture.
To slow down skin aging, avoiding smoking and alcohol is one of the most effective measures—and a huge favor to your overall health!
GET Enough Sleep

The so-called “beauty sleep” is no myth: While you sleep, your skin regenerates. It repairs cell damage and produces new collagen, which is essential for firmness and elasticity. Additionally, your circulation improves, ensuring your skin receives oxygen and nutrients.

Chronic lack of sleep not only causes signs of fatigue like dark circles and dull skin but also leads to loss of elasticity and faster wrinkle formation. So if you want to do something good for your skin, try going to bed a little earlier.
Reducing Stress

Under stress, your body releases cortisol. This hormone accelerates the breakdown of collagen and elastin, causing a loss of skin firmness and the formation of wrinkles. Blood circulation is also reduced, which hinders skin regeneration and makes it look tired and dull.

A balanced lifestyle not only boosts your overall well-being but also helps keep your skin healthy and youthful. Relaxation techniques such as meditation, yoga, or breathing exercises can help lower stress levels and slow down skin aging. Regular outdoor exercise also boosts circulation and supports skin regeneration.
USE Sunscreen

UV radiation is one of the main causes of premature skin aging and wrinkle formation. It damages both the outer and deeper layers of the skin and contributes to the breakdown of collagen and elastin. This results in decreased elasticity and the early appearance of wrinkles. To keep your skin looking young and healthy for as long as possible, apply sunscreen daily—regardless of the weather or time of year.

A broad-spectrum sunscreen with at least SPF 30 not only protects against sunburn and skin cancer but also helps prevent pigmentation spots and photoaging. Sensitive areas like the face, neck, and décolleté particularly benefit from regular protection.

Good to know: Even aesthetic treatments like wrinkle injections are most effective when the skin is protected from UV radiation. So there are plenty of good reasons to make sunscreen part of your daily routine.
